WITH schools_without_electricity AS (
  SELECT 
    s."School Code",
    s."School Name",
    s."Block",
    e."Girls 2024",
    e."Boys 2024"
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" e
  JOIN "school_infrastructure" s ON e."School Code" = s."School Code"

)

  "Block",
  COUNT(*) AS school_count,
  SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_2024_enrolment
FROM schools_without_electricity
GROUP BY "Block"
ORDER BY "Block";
